title: The March 1942 Fire That Nearly Ended Ole Kirk's Toy Business
conflicts: Headcount: LEGO says 26 jobs saved and 40 employees the following year; Dansk Biografisk Leksikon says about 25 at war's end. Story uses only the 26 at the time of the fire. New factory: LEGO says finished 1943, History Hit says opened 1944; story gives both. Moulding machine 1946 (HISTORY) vs 1947 (History Hit); story says 'after the war'. Fire cause (short circuit) is not in LEGO's account; omitted.
notes: The details of the decision (offers from elsewhere, insurance shortfall, Vejle Bank loan) come only from LEGO's own history pages and are attributed to the company; the independent sources confirm the fire, the rebuilding in Billund and that he nearly gave up. Memoir lines are as quoted in English by LEGO. The 1924 fire (sons and wood shavings) is a separate episode and is not mentioned.
